messages:
Priya Nair: hey all, new hire here. my MacBook Air (M2) finished Kandji enrollment but on first reboot it asked for a FileVault recovery key and my account isn't listed to unlock. i'm stuck on the login screen. anyone know the quick recovery flow?
Sam Ortiz: welcome @Priya! that sounds like FV2 escaped to an escrow mismatch. can you confirm you were signed into Okta SSO during the initial setup? sometimes the user needs to finish the first login while connected to corp-vpn to escrow the key.
Priya Nair: i did sign into Okta on the web, but i wasn't on the VPN. i could get remote access if someone can give me a temp admin or we can do an MDM-triggered escrow.
IT Helpdesk Bot: Auto-check: device serial C02ABCD12345 not found in FV escrow. Suggested actions: request temporary admin or run "onboardctl fv-escrow" after network connect. Open ticket created #HWI-4786.
Lina Gomez: @Sam / @IT Helpdesk — IT policy prefers remote run of the escrow command instead of handing out temp admin. If Priya can plug into wired or corp-vpn we can push a remote command. Priya, can you join Zoom and share screen for a quick assist?
Priya Nair: i can join now. i'm on my iPhone hotspot currently though, will plug into office ethernet in ~15 min.
Sam Ortiz: okay. two quick troubleshooting commands to check status once you're on a trusted network:

```
sudo fdesetup status
profiles list
```
The profiles output should include the MDM profile and an "MDM: filevault" or similar. If fdesetup says "FileVault is On" but user not authorized, that indicates escrow not completed.
Priya Nair: pasted outputs from earlier session: 
```
FileVault is On.
No user is enabled for FV on this machine.
```
and profiles list printed the Kandji MDM profile id 9A3F...
Lina Gomez: thanks. since FV is on but no enabled user, escalation path: IT runs a remote escrowing job via Kandji (job: escrow-recovery-key). Sam — can you trigger from the Helpdesk runbook?
Sam Ortiz: triggering now. sending the remote command to the device. Priya, keep the laptop connected to corp-vpn when it runs. I'll post when the command completes. :gear:
IT Helpdesk Bot: Remote command "escrow-recovery-key" queued for device C02ABCD12345 by Sam Ortiz. Estimated time: 2 min.
Sam Ortiz: confirmed: job succeeded. Priya, you should get a prompt to enable your account for FileVault on next login. If not, we can create a temporary admin ticket for one-time local unlock.
Priya Nair: logged in after reboot — prompt showed up, i enabled my user and it allowed login. holy moly, thanks!! :relieved: already adding a note to my onboarding checklist.
Lina Gomez: fantastic. Priya, if you could add a 1-liner to the onboarding doc about staying on corp network during initial login (or plugging into ethernet), that would help new hires avoid this.
Priya Nair: will do. thanks everyone.
